[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). The verses the casting arrives at (2:5–2:7):

**2:5** μνημόνευε οὖν πόθεν ⸀πέπτωκας, καὶ μετανόησον καὶ τὰ πρῶτα ἔργα ποίησον· εἰ δὲ μή, ἔρχομαί ⸀σοι, καὶ κινήσω τὴν λυχνίαν σου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῆς, ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσῃς.

**2:6** ἀλλὰ τοῦτο ἔχεις ὅτι μισεῖς τὰ ἔργα τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν, ἃ κἀγὼ μισῶ.

**2:7** ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ φαγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «how might i bind myself to hunter biden's presidency?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (4–8 sentences). A casting is a new beginning — the witness is meeting this text for the first time — so this opening is an INCIPIT and carries the full grammar: mark the question the casting opens on as the ==nucleus== (never italicized — the underlay is the mark); set the poem's name and the two or three load-bearing concepts in **bold** at their first defining use; name what this operator will traverse; and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes — the handoff is the door. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"We are in the rite. The text the casting arrived at is the first letter of the seven — the letter to **Ephesus**, the church that endured and tested and did not faint, and then lost the one thing the endurance was for. Three verses: a command to remember the **fall** (πόθεν πέπτωκας — from where you have fallen, not merely that you fell but from *where*, the elevation being part of the wound), a parenthetical credit (you hate what I hate; something has been preserved in the ruins), and a promise sealed to the one who conquers — the **Tree of Life** in the paradise of God, the recovery of Eden as the prize of the one who turned back. The question the witness brought — *how might I bind myself to Hunter Biden's presidency?* — is a question about **attachment to a power that does not exist**, an office never held, a future that the historical record already closed. And that is what this rotation will traverse: across each axis the casting turns, it will find what the text's logic does to the desire to attach oneself to something that fell. ==The letter to Ephesus is addressed to a community that already knows what it is to have organized its whole life around something it believed would endure — and to have been wrong.== The archive reads Revelation as the earliest document in the New Testament, the seed from which the rest unfolds ([AXN:0349.GOVERNANCE.🔻🎪⏫❌🗼🏔️](https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/202/)); these seven letters are not epilogue but root, and this one in particular is the grammar of **metanoia** — the turn-back, the re-origination — which is the only motion the text authorizes when the lampstand has been threatened with removal. I hand this to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register, gender-neutral throughout — junzi renders as 'the superior person', never 'the superior man' ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior person...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"A lamp carried down the stairs it once lit: the superior person remembers the height by the cost of the descent, and does not lash the flame to a throne that was never built.","navigate":null}]}
